conditional_trs_notional.text: TRS 按名义额与系数 1 估算，实际敞口未经认证。

fund_reported_marks.text: 采用基金申报估值，不等同交易所收盘价。

shares_carried.text: 股数沿用或按披露事件调整，其他股本变化未完全核实。

share_rounding_delivery.text: 股数包含舍入及交付处理假设。

equal_common_preferred_participation.text: 普通股与优先股按等经济单位分配。

preferred_liquidation_unverified.text: 优先股清算权未独立核实。

extra_dividend_not_capitalized.text: 额外优先股股息未资本化。

fund_fx_interpretation.text: 汇率方向由基金披露佐证，并非认证定盘价。

fiscal_period_mismatch.text: 财报期与持仓日不同，存在财务滞后。

fiscal_53_week_ttm.text: 收入包含 53 周财年口径。

retrospective_date_only.text: 使用事后披露数据，披露日期不代表当日开盘已知。

proportional_a_h_participation.text: A/H 股按章程同比例分配，不假设两地同价。

pending_cancellation_economic_exclusion.text: 基准剔除待注销受限股，经济股数仍为假设。

reported_crossholding_book.text: 使用披露账面权益，保留交叉持股，未作当日重估。

reported_financial_precision.text: 财报存在原始舍入精度，计算小数不代表准确度。

reported_rounded_ordinary_quantity.text: Reported quantity types and scales form a conditional ordinary-unit estimate. Rounding envelopes exclude other unknown changes and do not certify exact outstanding.

treasury_quantity_inference.text: Additional treasury is explicitly inferred as zero from specified evidence, not observed as an exact count. Issued and outstanding quantities remain distinct.

locked_private_ordinary_mark.text: Transfer-restricted private ordinary units use the listed held-unit mark as an explicit assumption. Neither equal observed prices, zero discount nor certified residual-right equivalence is established.

reported_parent_equity_convention.text: Reported parent accounting equity is allocated under an explicit ordinary-equity convention; reserves/OCI remain included and common-only liquidation entitlement is not certified.

convertible_reserve_allocation.text: Baseline retains the supported convertible equity reserve. A distinct carrying-amount allocation sensitivity may deduct it once, without re-deducting liabilities or inferring an option price.

qualified_interim_review.text: Material qualified interim review and its actual affected scope are retained. As-reported amounts are not silently corrected, and annual audit assurance does not remove the interim qualification.

reported_consolidation_perimeter.text: Revenue spans the actual reported consolidation perimeter and changes. It is not constant-perimeter pro forma or legal-owner revenue, and non-operating associate earnings are not added to operating sales.

external_reference_fx.text: Company local-currency financial amounts use the external Federal Reserve H.10 local-units-per-USD reference. It is not the fund actual FX, a recovered security-local price, or an exchange close.

reference_fx_timing_mismatch.text: June30 New York noon external FX, published in the July6 fixed vintage, normalizes financials against independently given N-CSRS USD marks. No common timestamp or matching fund fixing is certified.
